code_prompt_defaults.object_description: a triangle split into adjacent smaller triangles by one interior segment, with visible angle measures and one marked target angle
code_prompt_defaults.json_output_contract: Return one JSON object with keys "answer" and "annotation".
code_prompt_defaults.json_output_contract_answer_only: Return one JSON object with key "answer".
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint: set "annotation" to a JSON object with exactly these keys: {annotation_keys}; each value must be the pixel point [x,y] at that keyed target angle, supporting angle, or shared vertex
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint: set "answer" to the target angle measure in degrees as an integer
